versions.changelog:
- Updated API documentation to include s3_token support and larger file upload options in the transcription endpoint.
- Clarified file size limits for uploads (up to 10 GB via /v1/upload/*).
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- Improved and clarified descriptions for accepted source values and file uploads.

- Updated the skill name and description for improved clarity and discoverability.
- Increased API version to 1.0.1 to reflect recent updates.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No functional changes to API usage or workflow.

Initial release of DaDaScribe skill for high-quality audio and video transcription.

- Supports transcription from YouTube URLs, direct audio/video links, or local files (100+ languages).
- Offers optional speaker diarization with named speakers and translation to up to 5 languages.
- Returns both plain text transcripts (.txt) and subtitle files (.srt, including translated subtitles).
- Status API allows polling for completion; results expire after 1 hour for privacy.
- Includes code examples and best practices for both API and Python package usage.
